archetypes.name: step3-parity
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 shell-to-Python ports have dense byte-contract compatibility risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the native plan-review loop and panel dispatch against the legacy Step 3 contracts. Focus on status mapping, result-env persistence, sentinels, continuation decisions, and override seams. Flag any missing shell behavior that could break /design pause or review recovery. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: trust-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The change adds new result-env and tmpdir trust-boundary writes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the new result-env writer and all Step 3 result persistence paths. Check symlink refusal, allowlisted keys, newline handling, atomic writes, and DESIGN_TMPDIR validation before mutation. Treat unsafe filesystem behavior as release-blocking. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
